# Stack - Gym Tracker

A local-first iOS workout app for split logging, muscle coverage, and workout visuals. No accounts. No tracking.

## Product
- iOS app: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/stack-gym-tracker/id6760980211
- Free to download.
- Built and operated by Lauterstar (https://lauterstar.com).
- Part of the Lauterstar ecosystem alongside DesignKit and HabitTracker.

## What Stack does
- Fast set logging: three-tap quick-adjust row for weight and reps.
- Personal records: every set checked against history; new PRs surface automatically.
- Muscle coverage: split-aware engine maps sets to muscle regions across the week.
- Progression trends: per-exercise dual-axis charts of weight vs volume over time.
- Local-first: data stays on-device; optional iCloud sync via Sign in with Apple.
- Health integration: optional Apple Health writes, Live Activity, Dynamic Island.

## Audience
Lifters who train hard but have trouble sticking with tracking. People who care about quiet, fast logging over leaderboards and notifications.
